documented_external_dependencies: Python3.12.11 / Biopython1.85 and transitive runtime/OS libraries from existing declared environment
identity_crosswalk_caveat: The archived packaged relationship table is explicitly read to preserve fixed baseline locus IDs; native loci are computed fresh. No frozen window/gene output table is read during extraction.
enforcement_limit: Python audit hooks enforce file opens, directory reads, SQLite database path, subprocess/network and model-import restrictions. This is not a separate kernel container or syscall tracer; no cross-machine execution is claimed.
